_doc: #798 THE ONE declaration of sound identification, shared by every app that compiles this contract (Cloud Calc's 'What is this sound?' and Cloud Camera's Sound mode): which routes exist, which is the default, what the on-device engine is asked for, how long a capture is, and which classes are good enough to tag a photo with. libs:ml-l-sound bakes it into BuildConfig (SOUND_CONFIG_B64); SoundConfig reads it and every classify request carries the `ml` block, so the engine (Cloud-Lib-Ml-L-Sound-Yamnet.apk) holds no thresholds of its own. Per device, each app keeps only the user's route (SoundPrefs).
_doc_routes: ml = YAMNet (521 AudioSet classes) in the engine APK: fully offline, the default. openrouter = the app's own decision model asked about the measurements (Cloud Calc's build.json::jev.identify.sound): the engine has no network and no such route, so only an app that declares one offers it, and it stays optional.
_doc_ml: top_k classes with a mean score of at least min_score are returned; a window whose best class scores segment_min or more joins the timeline; the engine reads at most max_ms of a clip.
_doc_capture: How long the apps listen for one identification (default_ms, capped at max_ms) and at which rate they record. 16 kHz is the rate YAMNet reads, so no resampling happens on the common path.
_doc_tags: A photo is tagged with at most `max` ambient classes whose score is at least `min_score`.
